summary: Frontend-only testing of 3 new Planova features: Material drag&drop, Evening Report card, and Sammanfatta dagen (Day Summary + Daily trends). All 3 features work end-to-end. One bug found on /statistik: the 'Dagliga trender' section is hidden when the user has only saved day summaries but no classes/subjects/events, because it's gated behind the general hasAnyData guard.

ui_bugs.issue: section-daytrends-stats is rendered inside the `hasAnyData` branch (hasAnyData = classes || subjects || events). Users who only fill out 'Sammanfatta dagen' without any classes/subjects still see the global empty state 'Inget att visa ännu...' and never see their day-trend charts. Requirement: after saving at least one day summary the section must appear (either charts or empty-hint variant).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Statistik.jsx around line 168/180: extend hasAnyData to also consider daySummaries (e.g. `classes.length || subjects.length || events.length || (planner.daySummaries||[]).length`), OR render <DayTrendsSection /> outside the hasAnyData gate so it can show its own empty/charts states independently.
critical_code_review_comments: Statistik.jsx: DayTrendsSection has its own graceful empty states (no trends / no summaries) but they are unreachable when the page falls into the global 'Inget att visa' branch.
EveningReport correctly hides when eveningMode is 'off' and shows when 'on'; heuristic 'auto' state depends on wall-clock hour which may be confusing but is per-spec.
DaySummaryCard prompt -> form -> saved-card flow is clean; Spara button disabled until at least one value chosen — good UX.
Material drag&drop uses application/planova-material MIME – works with real HTML5 drag and via simulated DataTransfer events. dragOverKey highlight logic is correct.
seed_data_creation: Added class '6A' and subject 'Matematik' via /installningar to enable Statistik tests. Uploaded small.txt on /material and moved it to Matematik folder via drag & drop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is frontend-only (localStorage). All new features work: (1) Material drag&drop moves file and shows 'Flyttad: <name>' toast, folders highlight via dragOverKey; (2) EveningReport (data-testid=evening-report) shows/hides correctly on evening-toggle; (3) DaySummaryCard flow prompt→form→card works; day-summary-edit-btn re-opens form. Installningar Dagliga trender section supports add/delete/reset. On /statistik, section-daytrends-stats renders both chart-trend-over-time and chart-trend-weekday when the app has classes/subjects AND a saved summary. BUG: without classes/subjects/events the entire Statistik page short-circuits to empty state and DayTrendsSection never renders — see action_items.
rca of the issue: Root cause: in Statistik.jsx (line ~168) hasAnyData = classes.length>0 || subjects.length>0 || events.length>0. daySummaries are not part of this check, so the DayTrendsSection JSX (line 287) is never mounted when only day summaries exist. Mitigation: include daySummaries in the flag, or lift DayTrendsSection out of the ternary.
